title: DeliveryIssue
description: One YouTrack issue as read by the credential-owning `youtrack` service for `factory` (D113 clause 1). Returned by `GET /delivery/v1/issues/{vendorId}` and as the element of `delivery.issue-page`. A snapshot, not a live object: `readAt` says when it was true. Factory never receives a YouTrack credential; this shape carries no token, no authenticated vendor URL, and nothing that lets a consumer write to YouTrack directly.

description.description: Raw issue description as stored (Markdown). Empty string when the issue has none.

acceptance.description: Acceptance material the service could identify on the issue (a configured custom field, or an `Acceptance criteria` section of the description), verbatim. `null` when none was found. The service never synthesizes criteria; deriving testable criteria is Factory's job (work order step 2).

priority.description: The project's `Priority` value, verbatim; `null` when the project has no priority field or it is unset.

updated.description: Vendor last-modified time. Changes on ANY edit, including Factory's own comments/links/transitions, so it is an ordering key only, never a scope-change signal; use `scope.fingerprint` for that.

subtasks.description: Direct subtasks (`parent for`). Non-empty means this issue is a container; Factory treats containers as not directly executable (work order step 2: epics are containers, not jobs).

dependencies.description: Every `depends on` / `is required for` link the service could read.

dependenciesComplete.description: `true` only when every dependency link on the issue was read AND each linked issue's resolution was determined. `false` when any linked issue was inaccessible, the link list was truncated, or the link read failed. Consumer rule: dependencies are satisfied ONLY when this is `true` and every `depends-on` entry has `status: resolved`. Anything else is blocked or unknown, never satisfied.

deliveryLinks.description: Factory delivery links this service previously wrote to the issue and can still read back (sync operation kind `link`). Lets Factory find and reopen its existing active delivery for the issue instead of creating a second one.

field.description: Name of the project's state custom field (usually `State`).

name.description: Actual current state value, verbatim from the project's own workflow.

resolved.description: The vendor's own `isResolved` flag for this value, not inferred from the name.

scope.title: DeliveryIssueScope
scope.description: Owner-authored scope of the issue, fingerprinted so Factory can detect material edits (D113 clause 3) without being invalidated by its own synchronization writes.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON (sorted keys, UTF-8, no insignificant whitespace) of an object holding exactly the fields named in `fields`, as read.

fields.description: Which fields entered the fingerprint, e.g. `summary`, `description`, `acceptance`, `type`, `priority`, `parent`, `dependencies`. MUST exclude `state`, comments, delivery links, `updated` and anything the delivery surface itself writes, so a Factory link/comment/transition never changes the fingerprint.

direction.description: `depends-on`: this issue waits on `issue`. `required-for`: `issue` waits on this one (ordering information only).

issue.description: `null` when a link exists but the service cannot see the linked issue.

status.description: `unknown` when the linked issue's state could not be read. Never read as satisfied.

operationKey.description: The sync operation that wrote this link.
